notes: Journal entries. Unlocked by story actions. 'quote' refers to quotes.json.

lore_hunt.title: The Hunt
lore_hunt.text: Eight years of poverty; five years of hunting woods that seasoned hunters fear. The family's last loaf was eaten yesterday.

lore_wolf.title: The Wolf
lore_wolf.text: A wolf the size of a pony, too quiet for its size. Wolf or faerie, the ash arrow did its work. Its name, she will learn later, was Andras.

lore_ash.title: Mountain Ash
lore_ash.text: Faeries hate iron, but it is ash wood that makes their immortal healing falter long enough for a mortal to make a killing blow. The High Fae burned nearly every ash tree long ago.

lore_paint_tins.title: Three Tins of Paint
lore_paint_tins.text: Red, yellow and blue, bought by Elain the one summer the family had coin to spare. Vines along the windows, flames on the hearthstones, stars around Feyre's drawer.

lore_vow.title: The Vow
lore_vow.text: Eleven years ago, at her mother's deathbed. In the mortal world a promise is law, currency, bond.

lore_treaty.title: The Treaty
lore_treaty.text: After the War, six mortal queens forged the Treaty. The North went to the High Fae and faeries; the South to mortals. A wall, invisible and warded, was raised between.

lore_children.title: Children of the Blessed
lore_children.text: Zealots who worship the High Fae and send 'offerings' over the wall. None come back.

lore_martax.title: Martax
lore_martax.text: Body like a bear's, head something like a lion's, three rows of teeth sharper than a shark's. A pack crossed the wall and tore half a village apart.

lore_iron.title: Iron
lore_iron.text: Mortals wear iron against the Fae: bracelets, necklaces, cuffs. Whether it helps is another matter.

lore_silverspring.title: Silverspring Creek
lore_silverspring.text: In spring the rabbits make their warrens in the grove south of the big bend.

lore_life_for_life.title: A Life for a Life
lore_life_for_life.text: Any unprovoked attack on faerie-kind by humans is to be paid by a human life. Most mortals have chosen to forget that part of the Treaty.

lore_wall.title: The Wall
lore_wall.text: Two days north of the village. She crosses it asleep, bound by magic she can taste like metal.

lore_high_fae.title: The High Fae
lore_high_fae.text: Tall, fair, pointed of ear, and beautiful past bearing; they live for centuries. The lesser faeries come in every other shape there is. At this court, everyone wears a mask, and none of them can take it off.

lore_cross_wall.title: A Life Across the Wall
lore_cross_wall.text: The Treaty's price, paid another way: she lives out her days in Prythian instead of dying for the wolf. Her family will want for nothing, he swears, and he cannot lie. Or so she believes.

lore_blight.title: The Sickness
lore_blight.text: Something has been wrong in Prythian for nearly fifty years. It drains the High Fae's magic and emptied this house of most of its court. Nobody here will say more, and the masks stay on.

lore_bogge.title: The Bogge
lore_bogge.text: It hunts by being seen. Look at it and it becomes real enough to kill you; keep your eyes ahead and it cannot hold you. Tamlin hunts it alone, and comes home bloody.

lore_puca.title: The Puca
lore_puca.text: It wears whatever you want most, to lead you somewhere quiet. Then it eats you, slowly. It is a thing of the wind and the weather, of no court at all, and it should never have dared come this close.

lore_courts.title: The Seven Courts
lore_courts.text: Spring just north of the wall, which gave up the most land to mortals. Then Summer, Autumn and Winter; Dawn and Day; and in the far north, over frozen mountains, the Night Court. At the heart of it all, one bare mountain the weather will not touch.

lore_suriel.title: The Suriel
lore_suriel.text: An ancient faerie that knows a great many things, and must answer whoever snares it. Robes, bone, too many teeth. It told her to stay with the High Lord and stop asking questions, and then it told her more anyway.

lore_hybern.title: Hybern
lore_hybern.text: A faerie kingdom across the western sea, ruled by a lone king on a throne of human bones. He always hated the Treaty. A century ago he sent his deadliest commanders into every court in the world, and nearly fifty years ago one of them disobeyed him: the Deceiver. Then the Suriel stopped, and the naga came.

lore_naga.title: The Naga
lore_naga.text: Shadow and hate and rot in the shape of men: scales, talons, a silver forked tongue. They are not of the Spring Court; they belong to someone else. Tamlin tore them apart for touching her.

lore_high_lords.title: High Lords
lore_high_lords.text: Each of the seven courts answers to a High Lord. They are not merely powerful: they are Power. Tamlin is High Lord of the Spring Court, and he never wanted to be.

lore_lies.title: Faerie Lies
lore_lies.text: Faeries can lie, and think of it as an art; iron does them no harm. Their oldest lie was telling mortals they couldn't. Only ash wood truly hurts them. Tamlin swears he has never knowingly lied to her.

lore_attor.title: The Attor
lore_attor.text: Gray, leathery, winged, all teeth and whisper. It came into the rose garden asking after a human, and Tamlin answered it with a lie. It serves someone in the north.

lore_night_court.title: The Night Court
lore_night_court.text: The northernmost court: a land of darkness and starlight, with a sigil of a mountain and three stars. The head on the heron was its idea of a joke, and its High Lord laughed hardest.

lore_rhysand.title: Rhysand
lore_rhysand.text: High Lord of the Night Court: violet eyes, wreathed in night, and a mind that can seize hers like a fist. He saved her on Fire Night, and made Tamlin kneel at his feet. He calls himself Amarantha's whore, and says he has his reasons.

lore_amarantha.title: Amarantha
lore_amarantha.text: At last, a name for the female shadow over their lives. Deadly enough to command the High Lords; she holds Rhysand's leash, and Tamlin begged to keep Feyre hidden from her. Somewhere called Under the Mountain, she is waiting for him.
